publicClaims: Synthetic FHIR workflow and review-governance contracts executed in GitHub Actions

PostgreSQL 17 integration contract executed in GitHub Actions

PostgreSQL 17 review-governance contract executed in GitHub Actions, including durable decision replay and conflict handling, separation of duties, second-approval replay, and persisted reviewer metadata
Container build, compiled-runtime load, and non-root execution validated in GitHub Actions
Dependency audit and CycloneDX SBOM generation executed in GitHub Actions

Workflow governance coverage is gated in GitHub Actions at 85% lines, 70% branches, and 80% functions; observed workflow.js coverage was 88.80% lines, 75.90% branches, and 80.77% functions

Outbox reliability coverage is independently gated in GitHub Actions at 80% lines, 70% branches, and 85% functions; observed events.js coverage was 81.09% lines, 74.25% branches, and 88.57% functions on the isolated 16-test reliability and delivery-contract surface
Epic and Surescripts are not integrated
Synthetic fixtures only; no real-world patient records are used and the project is not clinically deployed
